    print(''.join('#' if px[x,y][3] else '.' for x in range(w)), y)
# grayscale luminance of fg vs bg
def lum(c): 
    r,g,b=[v/255 for v in c[:3]]
    f=lambda u: u/12.92 if u<=0.03928 else ((u+0.055)/1.055)**2.4
    return 0.2126*f(r)+0.7152*f(g)+0.0722*f(b)
fg=(112,185,237); bg=(0x17,0x23,0x36)
L1,L2=lum(fg),lum(bg)
print('contrast', (max(L1,L2)+0.05)/(min(L1,L2)+0.05))
